warning: DEFAULT PLACEHOLDER COEFFICIENTS. Replace with values from ARR2019 Book 2 Chapter 4 Table 2.4.1 for your design region before any engineering use. While verified=false, every ARF-adjusted result is rendered with an explicit 'unverified coefficients' flag.
form_description: Generalised ARR2019 long-duration ARF (Book 2 Ch. 4): ARF = min(1, 1 - a*A^b*D^(-c) + d*A^e*D^(-f)*(0.3+log10(AEP)) + g*10^(h*A*D/1440)*(0.3+log10(AEP))). Area A in km^2, duration D in minutes, AEP as fraction (e.g. 0.01 for 1%).

validity.note: Long-duration ARR2019 ARF. For durations < 24 h use a short-duration ARF (different equation form); Stormgrid will flag results as extrapolated rather than silently apply this form outside its documented validity range.

east_coast_north.label: East Coast North (covers the Sydney / Northern Beaches region per ARR2019)
east_coast_north.source_note: Coefficients are placeholder defaults that yield monotonic ARFs of the right shape (decreasing with area, approaching 1 for small areas). Verify against ARR2019 Book 2 Chapter 4 Table 2.4.1 before any engineering use.
